implementation_summary: Added an end-to-end test of the audit AI flow through the barrel (scoreFindings, rankFindingsWithIdMap, checkCitations, assessPages, assessSite, recommendPages, recommendationFor, writeRewrite). It uses a recording MockAIProvider subclass and a small hand-built audit with two Layout Groups and one covered page. It covers ranking order, citations, six areas per Sample Page and site-wide, one recommendation per Sample Page, claim-word repair, no ADR 0018 word in the output, model A for assessment and model B for rewrite (and the slot defaults when no per-stage model is set), and the no-key path. Added a source inspection test that lists every https URL under packages/core/src/audit/**, requires each host to be classified, checks that PageSpeed Insights v5 is the only external data API (through makeOutboundFetch, key in the x-goog-api-key header), and checks that ADR 0035 states free-tier use.
